newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Telkom bids close at 1700 GMT - sources.
newsitem.headline: S.African Telkom bids close at 1700 GMT - sources.

text.p: The tender for a strategic equity stake in South African telecommunications parastatal Telkom will close at 1700 GMT on Friday, according to industry sources.
The bids are being handled on behalf of the government by SBC Warburg in London.
A Telecommunications Ministry spokesman said a statement would be issued next week, but declined to give any further details.
SBC Communications Inc and Telekom Malaysia Bhd have said they intend to bid jointly for a 20 to 30 percent stake in Telkom which is expected to net government between five and six billion rand.
Deutsche Telekom AG and France Telecom have also been shortlisted as bidders by the government.

The deal, which could value Telkom at more than $4 billion, will be the largest privatisation in Sub-Saharan Africa and marks the first major step in the South African government's privatisation drive.
